description: Proprietor commenced new commercial retail trading firm by depositing cash capital ₹5,00,000 into business cash box
narration: Being cash capital introduced by proprietor to commence trading business
explanation: Increases Cash Asset (Debit Cash A/c ₹5,00,000) and creates Owner Equity/Capital Liability (Credit Capital A/c ₹5,00,000).

description: Proprietor introduced additional capital consisting of cash ₹1,00,000, bank deposit ₹2,50,000, shop furniture ₹40,000, and motor delivery van ₹1,60,000
narration: Being additional capital introduced in cash, bank balance, furniture, and motor vehicle
explanation: Compound Capital Entry: Debits all incoming asset accounts (Total Dr ₹5,50,000) and credits Proprietor Capital A/c ₹5,50,000.

description: Proprietor brought personal laptop worth ₹65,000 into business office for official accounting use
narration: Being personal laptop asset introduced into business as capital
explanation: Personal asset brought into business: Debit Computer Equipment Asset A/c ₹65,000, Credit Capital Equity A/c ₹65,000.

description: Proprietor withdrew cash ₹15,000 from business cash box for personal domestic household expenses
narration: Being cash withdrawn by proprietor for personal household domestic expenses
explanation: Personal cash withdrawal: Debit Drawings A/c ₹15,000 (reducing Owner Capital equity) and Credit Cash Asset A/c ₹15,000.

description: Paid proprietor's child school tuition fees ₹22,000 directly from SBI Bank account via online transfer
narration: Being proprietor's child school tuition fees paid from business bank account
explanation: Personal expense paid from business bank account is treated as Drawings: Debit Drawings A/c ₹22,000, Credit Bank Asset A/c ₹22,000.

description: Proprietor took inventory merchandise (cost price ₹10,000, retail sale price ₹14,000) for personal family gift
narration: Being inventory goods withdrawn by proprietor at cost price for personal family use
explanation: Goods withdrawn by owner are ALWAYS valued at COST PRICE (not sale price) to reduce Purchases: Debit Drawings A/c ₹10,000, Credit Purchases A/c ₹10,000.

description: Paid proprietor's personal income tax assessment ₹35,000 by SBI Bank cheque
narration: Being proprietor's personal income tax paid from business bank account
explanation: In sole proprietorship, Income Tax is the PERSONAL tax liability of the owner (not a business expense): Debit Drawings A/c ₹35,000, Credit Bank A/c ₹35,000.

description: Paid proprietor's Life Insurance Policy (LIC) premium ₹18,000 by SBI Bank cheque
narration: Being proprietor's personal life insurance premium paid from bank account
explanation: Life insurance of proprietor is a personal security expense: Debit Drawings A/c ₹18,000, Credit Bank Asset A/c ₹18,000.

description: Paid proprietor's personal medical clinic treatment bill ₹14,000 from business cash box
narration: Being proprietor's personal medical bill paid from cash box
explanation: Personal medical expense: Debit Drawings A/c ₹14,000, Credit Cash A/c ₹14,000.

description: Paid proprietor's personal residence electricity bill ₹6,200 from business bank account
narration: Being personal residence electricity bill paid from business bank account
explanation: Personal home electricity bill: Debit Drawings A/c ₹6,200, Credit Bank A/c ₹6,200.
